Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

July 3rd 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that Admiral Sah, who is staying in the Palace Hotel visited the Arsenal on the afternoon of 1st inst and had a long consultation with General Yang. It is said that they discussed the abolition of the post of Deputy Military Governor of Shanghai, the combination of the army and navy, and the withdrawal of surplus troops at present in the vicinity of Shanghai.
It is reported that a representative of Admiral Lee Ting Sung called on Admiral Sah on 1st inst and that they almost reached an agreement regarding the cancellation of the independence of the Navy.
On the afternoon of 1st inst several naval officers and men hold a meeting at No.276 Rue Kraetzer and had a discussion as to whether they should agree or not to the cancellation of independence. They failed to decide on any definite course of action.
It is expected in well informed circles in the City that the services of Zoe Kou Liang will soon be dispensed with.
At 2.40 p.m. 2nd inst a bomb explosion occurred at No.53 Rue Marcel Tillot as a result of which one man was killed, while one man, three women and three children were injured. It appears that the occupants of the house in question were rebels, and that they were engaged in making bombs. Some of the bombs had become wet and they had been placed on the verandah to dry. It was one of these which exploded. The explosion was very severe. The house where it occurred was almost demolished, and the houses adjoining it on either side were damaged.
Commencing from Wednesday 5th inst the workmen who were recently discharged from the Arsenal will be reinstated.
General Yang is indisposed since Saturday night. He is suffering from diarrhoea.
There are only two detectives employed by the Arsenal at present. The others were paid two months wages and discharged.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名） 3/7/16 （签名）
ptain Superintendent of Police. Chief Detective Inspector.

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1916年7月3日。

先生：

据报，萨镇冰海军上将下榻于皇宫饭店（Palace Hotel），于本月1日下午访问了兵工厂，并与杨将军进行了长时间磋商。据悉，他们讨论了撤销上海副都督一职、海陆军合并以及撤走目前驻扎在上海周边的多余部队等事宜。

据报，李鼎新海军上将的代表于本月1日拜访了萨镇冰海军上将，双方就取消海军独立一事几乎达成协议。

本月1日下午，数名海军军官和士兵在克勒策尔路（Rue Kraetzer）276号举行会议，讨论是否同意取消海军独立。他们未能就任何明确的行动方案作出决定。

据本市消息灵通人士预期，左汝良（Zoe Kou Liang）的服务将很快被终止。

本月2日下午2时40分，马塞尔·蒂约路（Rue Marcel Tillot）53号发生炸弹爆炸，导致一人死亡，一人、三名妇女和三名儿童受伤。看来该房屋的居住者是反叛分子，当时正在制造炸弹。部分炸弹受潮，被放置在门廊上晾干。其中一枚发生了爆炸。爆炸威力巨大。事发房屋几乎被夷为平地，两侧相邻的房屋也遭到损坏。

自本月5日（星期三）起，近期从兵工厂解雇的工人将复职。

杨将军自周六晚起身体不适。他患有腹泻。

目前兵工厂仅雇佣了两名侦探。其余人员已领取两个月工资后被解雇。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名） 16年7月3日 （签名）
警司。 首席侦探督察。

（手写批注：利益为零 / ... 3）
